_note: Cause areas used by the Values Compass, the Portfolio Builder and the Cause Atlas. Dimension positions run from 0 to 1 and are editorial judgments, not measurements. Challenge any of them with a pull request that explains why.

dimensions.horizon: 0 = helps people alive now, 1 = protects people not yet born
dimensions.circle: 0 = centered on humans, 1 = all living things
dimensions.certainty: 0 = proven and measurable, 1 = speculative with large upside
dimensions.depth: 0 = most work is relief, 1 = most work targets structures and sources
